seo.h1: M-895 Titanium Dioxide for Architectural and Industrial Coatings

hero.summaryLead: A chloride-process rutile titanium dioxide pigment documented for interior and exterior architectural coatings and industrial coatings.
hero.summaryBody: M-895 combines alumina and zirconia inorganic coating with organic treatment. Its current technical data identifies dispersion, opacity, gloss, a bright blue-toned white and weather resistance as key evaluation directions. Review the typical product data below and confirm suitability through testing in your own formulation, processing and application conditions.

positioning.heading: Where M-895 Fits in Product Evaluation
positioning.lead: M-895 is a rutile titanium dioxide pigment manufactured by the chloride process for coatings evaluation.
positioning.body: Its documented product profile combines alumina and zirconia inorganic coating with organic treatment and a focused application range covering interior architectural, exterior architectural and industrial coatings. Use M-895 as a candidate for formulation testing when dispersion, opacity, gloss, color direction and weather-resistance targets are relevant. Final Grade selection should account for the complete formulation, dispersion process, substrate, application method, service conditions and destination-document requirements.
decisionPoints: Interior and exterior architectural coating directions
Evaluation of dispersion, opacity, gloss, blue-toned whiteness and weather resistance

applications.heading: Coating Application Directions to Evaluate
applications.intro: Review each documented direction in the buyer's own formulation, processing and application conditions.

items.title: Interior Architectural Coatings
items.body: Evaluate M-895 in the intended interior architectural coating formulation. Confirm dispersion, opacity, gloss, color direction, compatibility and finished-film appearance under the actual application conditions.

items.title: Exterior Architectural Coatings
items.body: Review M-895 in exterior architectural coating systems where weather resistance and appearance are part of the qualification target. Confirm performance in the complete formulation and intended exposure conditions.

items.title: Industrial Coatings
items.body: Include M-895 in industrial coating formulation testing when dispersion, opacity, gloss, color direction and weather resistance are relevant to the project. Validate the result with the actual binder, substrate, application and curing process.

evaluation.heading: What to Evaluate in Your Coating Formulation
evaluation.intro: Use the documented M-895 profile and typical data to frame buyer testing.

groups.heading: Optical and Appearance Review
items: Dispersion behavior in the selected binder and processing system
Opacity target in the complete formulation
Bright blue-toned white direction under the intended color system

groups.heading: Durability and Qualification Review
items: Weather-resistance target under the intended service conditions
Compatibility with the full formulation and additives
Interior, exterior or industrial application conditions, as applicable
Substrate, application method, curing conditions, destination requirements and sample-validation results

evaluation.disclaimer: These evaluation priorities identify what to check during buyer testing. They do not guarantee a fixed result in every formulation, process or service environment.
